description: Records the post-compaction marker. The module reports context-zone crossings to Claude, gates new mutating work in blocking mode, draws the band row, serves a status tool and writes the per-session snapshot.

hooks.command: sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/prerequisites.sh" node-notice /context-guard:check CONTEXT_GUARD_HOOKS_ENABLED; ${PPID:+exit}; powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/prerequisites.ps1" node-notice /context-guard:check CONTEXT_GUARD_HOOKS_ENABLED
hooks.statusMessage: Checking that node is on PATH...
